requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1434-1704-4549--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1434-1704-4549--227.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary creature you control, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 8 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

4770-5223-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-3480-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2281-3305-4247.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-4676-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

978-2420-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1640-5109-7839.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Smaug and the creature with Pariah's Shield attached.
Smaug triggers, creating an amount of Treasure tokens equal to the damage it was dealt.

670-1619-3742-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6145.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Passageway Seer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Passageway Seer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Passageway Seer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
206-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
206-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2024-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W} equal to its power.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Mona Lisa and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2024-7308.notes: The cost can be reduced to a minimum of {G/W} depending on Mona Lisa's power to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Sailor of Means

1409-1770-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve both Sailor of Means triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4500-4826.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

967-2097-3809-6798-7087.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6773-7060.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3446-3532-3761-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-3761-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

2034-2350-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4608-4890-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate.
4608-4890-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4608-4890-5466.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Dack's Duplicate's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Dack's Duplicate's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

851-4365-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
851-4365-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
851-4365-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1617-1883-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Replication Technique.
1617-1883-4831-4983-5358.description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-1883-4831-4983-5358.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-2719-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces has a power of at least 2.
1912-2719-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2092-4613-4617.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-2092-4613-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding eight {R}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2882-3704-4679-4772-5299.manaNeeded: {7}{U}, plus enough mana to cast the double-faced creature or enchantment
2882-3704-4679-4772-5299.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You have a transforming double faced creature or enchantment card in hand.
2882-3704-4679-4772-5299.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Doubling Season.
Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, attaching it to Inventive Iteration.
When Infinite Reflection enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each nontoken creature you control to become a copy of Inventive Iteration.
Cast any transforming double-faced creature or enchantment card by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Inventive Iteration with four chapter counters due to Infinite Reflection and the Doubling Season tokens.
The creature or enchantment's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first and second triggers, returning up to one creature or planeswalker to its owner's hand, and then either returning an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand or causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the third trigger, exiling the creature or enchantment, and returning it to the battlefield transformed as a copy of Inventive Iteration with four chapter counters due to Infinite Reflection and the Doubling Season tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
When your library is down to one card remaining, use the creature's first trigger to return the original Inventive Iteration to your hand, thus ending the loop.

435-4618-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {2}.
 Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
435-4618-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Instill Energy attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Instill Energy token by paying {0}, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing the Instill Energy token, causing Auratog to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-3008-3048-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3008-3048-4186.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature it is attached to to become a copy of Roalesk.
Put the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The creature triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1558-2535-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least four descent counters on it.
1558-2535-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Protection: Red by paying {1}, preventing the next amount of damage Descent into Avernus would deal you this turn.
Resolve the Descent into Avernus trigger, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus, and causing each opponent to be dealt an amount of damage equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

891-1703-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Repeat.

2580-3571-5141.description:
Cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Activate Lethal Vapors an arbitrarily large number of times.
Maintaining priority, cast Trickbind by paying {1}{U}, countering one of those triggers and preventing Lethal Vapors from being activated again until end of turn.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}: until your next turn your life total can't change and you have protection from everything.
Allow all the activated abilities from Lethal Vapors to resolve, skipping an arbitrarily large number of turns.
